You can confirm whether the issue you’re seeing was a known platform incident by checking Meridian’s status page:

1. Open the status page and look at the list of incidents. It shows every incident (including brief ones) with exact start and end times and the components affected.
2. Use the component‑level breakdown to see if the API, dashboard, or any other part matches the symptom you experienced.
3. If the incident happened earlier in the day, you can still view it in the page’s history to verify the time window.

If you need ongoing alerts, you can subscribe to notifications scoped to the specific components you care about, so you’ll be notified only for relevant incidents.

Let us know if you need any further help!
